text_block_list.text:
The Summer Training Camp finally begins today!
I want to go all out training for the Kikuka Sho,
the final leg of the Classic Triple Crown—
...However, even before that, Admire Vega seemed busy with something the moment she arrived at the training camp.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me.
...Have you seen Shinko Windy?
choice_data_list: No, I didn't see it, though...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Right. ...Ah, geez.
Where did she wander off to...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-saaann!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Windy-san, we found it!!
Thank you so much for your help--!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Uggh... Why did you come looking for meee?!
Just leave me alone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I can't just leave you be!
We're classmates, after all!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Come on, roll call by class is over there.
Please stay with me just a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
…………
I-It can't be helped, nanoda...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... So Windy-san was here.
In that case, all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-kun! If you're looking for Taishin, Ticket just dragged her back to our class's line a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was surrounded by a crowd from other classes getting off the bus, got overwhelmed, and took a rest in the corner.
Sorry for the trouble.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you've found them, that's fine.
...That makes everyone, then.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: “—Top Road-san! We can do roll call now.”

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah, okay~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then... Thank you for the report,
Class Rep.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to leave it all to you when our class is full of problem children.
As a fellow classmate,
I only wish I could be of more help.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you're already holding the entire student body
together as part of the student council, Air Groove-san.
Please leave our class to me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Or so I say, but Ayabe-san actually
helped me out a whole bunch!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...We can't move forward with preparing for training
until roll call is finished, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, but it really saved me!
So much!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, yeah, I get it.

It was a moment that offered a brief glimpse
of Admire Vega in the classroom—
somewhat different from her usual devoted self in training.
